headword: {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}

definitions.explanation: An electronic gate at train stations that reads tickets or IC cards to allow passengers through. A ubiquitous feature of Japanese public transportation.

examples.japanese: {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}にカードをかざす。
examples.english: To tap a card on the automatic ticket gate.

examples.japanese: {切符|きっぷ}を{自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}に{通|とお}してください。
examples.english: Please insert your ticket into the automatic ticket gate.

examples.japanese: ICカードの{残高|ざんだか}が{足|た}りなくて、{自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}で{止|と}められた。
examples.english: I was stopped at the ticket gate because my IC card didn't have enough balance.

notes:
{自動改札機|じどうかいさつき} is composed of {自動|じどう} (automatic) + {改札|かいさつ} (ticket inspection) + {機|き} (machine).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}を{通|とお}る: to pass through the ticket gate
- {自動改札機|じどうかいさつき}にカードをタッチする: to touch a card to the gate

USAGE: In casual conversation, often shortened to {改札|かいさつ}. Japanese ticket gates accept both paper tickets (inserted into a slot) and IC cards like Suica and PASMO (tapped on a sensor).
